characters.name: Rowan
characters.role: Hearthkeeper, Farmer & Mine Delver of Oakhaven
characters.description: Resilient frontier artisan and keeper of Oakhaven's hearth. Equal parts capable farmer, deep-mine delver, and baker who keeps the wood stove roaring each night for a rugged frontier town.
characters.quote: These hands swing heavy pickaxes in the deep dark, yet know how to knead warm dough to banish the winter frost.
characters.schedule: Morning & Afternoon: Tending homestead & delving the 150-floor mine; Evening: Firing the ovens at the hearth
characters.real_world_wound: Burnout and Imposter Syndrome after fleeing urban exploitation; haunted by fear of failing Amalia's legacy.
characters.heart_event_summary: Reclaims self-worth through honest farm labor, 150-floor mine exploration, and serving 55 comforting hot meals to healing frontier townsfolk.

characters.name: Pip
characters.role: Pygmy Owl Messenger & Botanical Seed Forager
characters.description: A plump, intelligent little owl who brings mysterious botanical seeds back to your mailbox every morning.
characters.quote: Hoo... coo... *tilts head and blinks*
characters.schedule: Dawn: Delivers seeds to mailbox; Afternoon: Perches on porch
characters.real_world_wound: A loyal familiar who never abandons the mailbox, eagerly watching for town mail.
characters.heart_event_summary: Faithful morning companion; brings rare wild seeds from the Whispering Forest glade to Rowan's mailbox every dawn.

characters.name: Mallow
characters.description: A round calico cat who sheltered in the shop during a thunderstorm and never left; loves slumbering near warm lanterns.
characters.quote: Meow... *contented purrs*
characters.schedule: All day: Lounging warmly by the brick oven or timber counter
characters.real_world_wound: A stray rescue haunted by rain-storm abandonment, finding warmth beside the dining tavern fire.
characters.heart_event_summary: Activates passive "Lucky Hearth" buff when sleeping by the eatery fireplace: reduces dish burn rate by 15% and increases patron tip gold by 10%.

characters.name: Lumi
characters.description: Unique Kemomimi-Elf spirit featuring fluffy white fox ears atop jade twin-tails, pointed elven ears, and a soft crimson knitted scarf.
characters.quote: The howling forest winds tonight make my ears ring... could I have something cool and gentle to soothe my heart?
characters.schedule: Afternoon: Strolls through Whisperwood; Evening: Quiet corner at the eatery
characters.real_world_wound: Hybrid outcast shunned by both fae and beastfolk; yearns for warmth yet dreads hostility.
characters.heart_event_summary: Forecasts rare botanical herbs by weather at 4 Hearts; unlocks the hidden path to the Deep Forest Shrine to gather luminescent fungi at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Đi dạo hái dâu rừng và trò chuyện cùng muông thú
Ngồi dưới tán cây phong soi bóng đôi tai xù dưới làn nước
Ngồi ở chiếc bàn góc trong cùng, uống trà sen thanh dịu

rainy.activity: Trú mưa dưới tán lá khổng lồ nghe tiếng mưa rào
Vào tiệm hong khô khăn len đỏ bên lò sưởi ấm

characters.name: Boris Barnaby
characters.description: Stout, hardy dwarven smith with twin-braided russet beard and an ash-stained leather apron from years at the anvil.
characters.quote: Hammering steel all day leaves me bone-weary. The furnace is hot, but my heart feels cold... got anything sweet and fragrant with wild cinnamon?
characters.schedule: 07:00 - 18:00: At the forge anvil; 19:00: Cinnamon rolls at the eatery
characters.real_world_wound: Tormented by a 10-year-old mine collapse that crippled Bram; overprotective to a fault out of terror.
characters.heart_event_summary: Unlocks iron farm tool smithing at 4 Hearts; reconciles 10-year feud with brother Bram and unlocks the Advanced Refining Forge at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Thức dậy, nhóm lò than rực đỏ
Rèn nông cụ và mài kiếm cho mạo hiểm giả
Ăn bánh mì khô và uống nước lá đun sôi
Đập đe tôi thép, gia công cuốc xẻng
Đứng trước hiên nhìn về phía mỏ đá thở dài lo cho Bram
Ăn bánh nướng ấm áp bên bếp lò, nhâm nhi trà nóng
Về nhà nghỉ ngơi sau ngày dài quai búa

rainy.activity: Tránh mưa tạt, mài đinh tán và sửa bễ thổi
Kiểm kê than đá và quặng sắt tồn kho
Trú mưa sớm, gọi bát súp bò hầm nóng làm ấm xương khớp

sunny.activity: Dập lửa xả xỉ than bảo dưỡng định kỳ lò
Gặp Thuyền trưởng Garrick đẽo cán búa gỗ và nghe chuyện viễn du
Mua chút nhu yếu phẩm rồi về nhà

all_weather.activity: Đón thuyền buôn cập bến xem có quặng quý ngoại quốc
Ngồi đàm đạo cùng Maeve và Garrick
Bảo dưỡng bộ đồ nghề thợ rèn gia truyền

blizzard.activity: Giữ lửa lò sưởi ấm cho cả dãy phố biên viễn
Nhanh chóng ghé ăn bát súp nóng rồi về trực lò

characters.name: Maeve
characters.description: Gentle elder herbalist with silver hair pinned in a low bun and a spring-embroidered kerchief; foster grandmother to Kael.
characters.quote: The caterpillars were harsh on my pumpkins today. Weeding since midday has my old back aching, little witch...
characters.schedule: 06:00 - 17:00: Selling seeds in Town Square; Evening: Strolling riverside
characters.real_world_wound: Debilitating joint degeneration; fears dying and leaving orphaned Kael alone in a harsh world.
characters.heart_event_summary: Unlocks the Four-Seasons Nursery (basic greenhouse) at 4 Hearts; rests easy seeing Kael blossom and passes down master gardening wisdom at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Tưới luống sen tuyết và bắt sâu cùng Kael
Bày sạp bán hạt giống và hoa quả tươi

sunny.location: Gốc Cây Cổ Thụ Quảng Trường
sunny.activity: Cùng Kael ăn cơm nắm mè rang dưới bóng mát
Ngồi ghế bập bênh xâu hạt hoa và đan khăn len
Dặn Kael đóng cửa chuồng gà và vào ăn tối

rainy.activity: Mưa tự tưới cây nên ở trong nhà xoa dầu tràm lên khớp gối
Dạy Kael tập đọc chữ qua các túi đựng hạt giống
Sang trò chuyện cùng Rowan và uống trà hoa cúc ấm

sunny.activity: Đón tàu Garrick xem có hạt giống hải ngoại độc lạ
Hàn huyên cùng hội phụ lão Oakhaven

blizzard.activity: Chăm chút vài chậu mầm nhạy cảm với sương giá
Hầm nồi súp bí đỏ hạt sen bồi dưỡng cho Kael

characters.name: Kael
characters.description: An orphaned boy with a pointed wool cap, patchworked winter coat, and bright curious eyes; Maeve's beloved ward.
characters.quote: Grandma Maeve's knees have been aching in the damp air... Can I trade my matchboxes for some ginger tea for her?
characters.schedule: Morning: Practice yard; Evening: Sipping cold berry tea
characters.real_world_wound: Acute abandonment trauma; overworks himself in freezing gales out of terror of being discarded.
characters.heart_event_summary: Receives rare heirloom seeds at 4 Hearts; upgrades the Automated Plant Propagation Station at 8 Hearts after healing the fear of abandonment.

sunny.activity: Hăng hái xách xô nước phụ bà Maeve tưới luống hoa
Chạy lăng xăng giúp bà giao túi hạt cho khách
Ngồi ăn cơm nắm và khoe với bà chiếc lông chim nhặt được
Chơi ném thia la lia đá trên mặt nước mát
Chạy sang xin Rowan bát súp ấm đem về cho bà

rainy.activity: Ngắm bong bóng mưa vỡ trên sân
Trú mưa bên bếp lửa, ngồi vẽ tranh cùng mèo Mallow
Đội nón lá chạy về nhà quây quần bên bà Maeve

all_weather.activity: Phụ bác Garrick vác bao tải nhỏ với vẻ mặt tự hào
Chạy đuổi bướm và hái hoa dại cắm bình cho bà

characters.name: Grandmother Amalia
characters.description: Rowan's late grandmother, legendary tea crafter whose warmth lives on through annotated grimoire margins and fond memory.
characters.quote: True magic isn't found afar; it lives in the care you pour into each tea leaf and warm morsel you bake for another.
characters.schedule: Present in grimoire margins, cherished memories, and dreams
characters.real_world_wound: Sacrificed her own health during famine years to keep the frontier settlement fed and alive.
characters.heart_event_summary: Guides Rowan through 55 heirloom recipes and the healing philosophy: "Cooking is to make others feel worthy of living and being loved."

characters.name: Bram
characters.description: Veteran miner prospecting the deepest mine levels; Boris's younger brother. Gruff and argumentative, but fiercely devoted to family.
characters.quote: My brother Boris is lecturing me about brittle iron ore again... Brew me something deeply bitter so I can swallow my temper!
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 17:00: Mine shafts entrance; Evening: Arguing at Boris's forge
characters.real_world_wound: Pride wounded by brotherly pity; dives into lethal depths to prove he is still a whole, capable man.
characters.heart_event_summary: Points out deep subterranean mineral veins at 4 Hearts; partners with brother Boris to unlock the Advanced Refining Forge at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Lén đi đường vòng sau núi né mặt anh trai Boris
Đào thạch anh và quặng sắt tầng nông
Ngồi bóp chiếc chân giả đau nhức, ăn củ khoai nướng
Lần mò tìm khoáng mạch mới
Ngắm ráng chiều buông xuống thung lũng Oakhaven
Chờ Boris về mới lén vào mua bánh mì đem về nhà ăn

rainy.activity: Mưa làm trơn trượt cửa hang, ngồi nhà mài lại lưỡi cuốc
Ngồi góc khuất nhìn ra ô cửa mưa rơi, uống trà đắng
Về lều thắp nến xem bản đồ trắc địa hang sâu

all_weather.activity: Ngồi thả cần câu một mình tránh xa sự ồn ào
Đứng đón gió núi làm dịu nỗi bức bối trong lòng

characters.name: Penny
characters.role: Pastry Courier & Hot Meal Delivery Service
characters.description: Energetic, nimble pastry seller; niece of Boris and Bram. Quick-witted, cheerful, and always inventing eccentric new baked goods.
characters.quote: Uncle Boris just tapped out a star-shaped cookie cutter for me! Let me try that tart berry tea to inspire my next batch!
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 16:00: Postal run; 18:00: Dropping letters off at the eatery
characters.real_world_wound: Orphaned niece raised by bachelor dwarven uncles; dreams of running an independent mobile bakery cart.
characters.heart_event_summary: Opens Plaza Pastry Rolling Cart at 4 Hearts; operates the Town Hot Meal Delivery service to courier meals to miners and villagers at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Đẩy xe bánh dạo nhỏ rộn rã tiếng chuông leng keng
Mang bánh mì qua cho chú Boris và chú Bram
Bán bánh cho các thủy thủ và khách vãng lai
Học hỏi bí quyết nướng bánh mới từ Rowan

rainy.activity: Mưa không đẩy xe bánh được, ở nhà thử nghiệm công thức bánh mới
Sang trò chuyện cùng Rowan và nhâm nhi trà ngọt

characters.name: Professor Orion
characters.description: Astronomer stationed atop the hill observatory; Clara's father. Absentminded and so captivated by constellations that he forgets meals.
characters.quote: The Cygnus constellation just shifted three degrees... My eyes are blurring, do you have a brew that lets my thoughts rest for two hours?
characters.schedule: Night: Stargazing at Observatory; Morning: Napping in library
characters.real_world_wound: Progressive dementia (Alzheimer's); desperately stays awake to spot his late wife's star before memory fades.
characters.heart_event_summary: Provides 2-day advance forecasts of anomalous weather (blizzards, miasma acid rain) at 4 Hearts; triggers the Meteor Shower Event yielding surface crystals at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Thức dậy sau đêm dài ngắm sao, dụi mắt tìm kính lão
Tìm sách cổ thiên văn, lẩm bẩm tên vợ Elise
Uống trà thảo mộc định thần do Clara dắt sang
Thức trắng đêm bên kính thiên văn truy tìm chòm sao Elise

rainy.activity: Mây mù che kín sao, bồn chồn lo lắng đi đi lại lại
Che ô rách đi lạc ngơ ngác giữa làn mưa
Được Clara tìm thấy và dắt về sưởi ấm

characters.name: Clara
characters.description: Meticulous curator of Oakhaven's archives; Orion's daughter. Organized, caring, and constantly reminding her father to take care of himself.
characters.quote: Father stayed up in the observatory tower for two days without food again... Could you brew a big pot of chamomile tea so I can make him drink it?
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 17:00: Library and dispensary; Evening: Calming lavender tea
characters.real_world_wound: Caregiver burnout; tore up a royal scholarship to care for her ailing father, mourning lost youth.
characters.heart_event_summary: Deciphers ancient texts at 4 Hearts; bequeaths the heirloom valley classic dessert recipe codex at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Nấu cháo yến mạch và để sẵn thuốc bổ cho cha
Mở cửa thư viện, phân loại bản đồ cổ và tài liệu
Đọc lại những bức thư học bổng cũ rồi cất vào ngăn kéo
Dắt cha sang uống trà, thưởng thức bánh quy bơ
Khóa cửa thư viện, chuẩn bị trà đêm cho cha

rainy.activity: Kê chậu hứng nước dột từ mái ngói cổ
Cầm ô hớt hải đi tìm cha đang đi lạc dưới mưa
Cùng cha trú mưa và uống trà nóng làm dịu thần kinh

characters.name: Captain Garrick
characters.description: Weathered sea captain who has hung up his oars; Finn's grandfather. Delights in recounting tales of uncharted celestial islands.
characters.quote: The valley wind smells of the great outer seas of my youth... Give an old sailor a robust spiced cup and listen to my stories of the floating isles.
characters.schedule: Sunday Morning: Anchoring his nautilus vessel by the pier market
characters.real_world_wound: Color-blind and arthritic; agonizes over feeling like beached driftwood stripped of purpose.
characters.heart_event_summary: Opens Mist Lake cargo boat dock at 4 Hearts; clears the maritime trade route to import exotic spices at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Kiểm tra neo tàu và vá lại mảnh lưới đánh cá
Dạy chú bé Finn cách thắt các nút dây thủy thủ
Hút tẩu thuốc lá ngắm mây trôi trên hồ nước
Kể chuyện quái vật biển mây cho khách nghe

rainy.activity: Uống ngụm rượu trái cây sưởi ấm, xoa ngực áo
Ngồi cạnh lò sưởi nhấp trà cay nồng nướng cá

all_weather.activity: Họp chợ phiên bờ hồ, trao đổi hải sản và đặc sản biển

characters.name: Finn
characters.description: Spirited boy who fishes along mountain streams and misty lakes; Garrick's grandson. Fascinated by luminous aquatic fauna.
characters.quote: I hooked a huge rainbow-glowing trout today! Grandpa Garrick said I could bring it by the eatery for a hot bowl of fish stew!
characters.schedule: 06:00 - 18:00: Angling by the starlight brook; Evening: Warming by tavern hearth
characters.real_world_wound: Fishes tirelessly to buy back the ancestral Silver Compass Garrick pawned for family medicine.
characters.heart_event_summary: Unlocks Fishing Rod & Lake Minigame at 4 Hearts; supplies bioluminescent fish for night-vision recipes in deep mines at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Thả cần câu cá sớm gom tiền chuộc la bàn cho ông
Giao mớ cá tươi câu được cho quán ăn của Rowan
Chơi đùa cùng Kael nhặt ốc sên và vỏ sò
Ngồi nghe ông nội Garrick kể chuyện phiêu lưu

rainy.activity: Ngồi bên ông nội quấn dây cước câu cá
Ăn bánh quy gừng thơm giòn ngắm mưa rơi

characters.name: Elora
characters.description: Graceful seamstress tailoring moonlight velvet robes; Sylvan's kindred spirit. Her fingers ache from days of meticulous silver needlework.
characters.quote: My fingertips sting from stitching gala robes with silver needles all day... Is there a jasmine blend that eases weary hands?
characters.schedule: All day: Tending Sylva-Fae canopy silk greenhouse
characters.real_world_wound: Joint tremor syndrome in her fingers after decades of nonstop needlework; fears losing her craft and disappointing beloved companions.
characters.heart_event_summary: Weaves Expanded Adventurer Pouch (+12 slots) at 4 Hearts; tailors the Eternal Winter Gala Robe for Rowan using Thistle's silk at 8 Hearts.

characters.name: Sylvan
characters.description: Monocled botanical researcher from the elven woods; Elora's confidant. Frequently trades ancient roots for grounding, hearty teas.
characters.quote: Poisonous mist hangs dense over the woods tonight... I brought you millennium roots, would you trade a warming earthy brew for them?
characters.schedule: Afternoon & Evening: Patrolling Sylva-Fae ancient boughs
characters.real_world_wound: Haunted by his inability to heal Mentor Fern blind eyes; constantly torments himself for lacking deeper botanical knowledge.
characters.heart_event_summary: Opens Herbal Essential Oil Extractor to enhance dish buff stats at 4 Hearts; harvests rare Millennial Roots at 8 Hearts.

characters.name: Marlo
characters.role: Night Watchman & Town Guard of Oakhaven
characters.description: A dependable local militia watchman patrolling Oakhaven's boundary gates by night. Drives off raiding wild boars, catches stray thieves, and keeps the peace around late-night tavern patrons.
characters.quote: Wind howls right through the gaps in my armor... On long night patrols, only your spicy tea keeps my eyes from snapping shut.
characters.schedule: 07:00 - 17:00: Operating Oakhaven windmill grinding flour
characters.real_world_wound: Supports 4 impoverished siblings back home; endures frozen nocturnal vigils in solitude.
characters.heart_event_summary: Reduces wild beast fence breaches by 50% at 4 Hearts; guarantees absolute nighttime security for town and homestead at 8 Hearts.

characters.name: Aurelia
characters.description: Caring town healer running the dispensary clinic. Believes wholesome teas heal spirits far deeper than bitter salves alone.
characters.quote: Potions only close surface wounds... Townspeople need your warm herbal teas to soothe their deeper quiet sorrows.
characters.schedule: Morning: Honeybee apiary; Afternoon: Delivering fresh honey to shop
characters.real_world_wound: Disgusted by commercial medicine prioritizing nobles; struggles with poverty-driven medical shortages.
characters.heart_event_summary: Brews Vitality Healing Broth to relieve chronic pain at 2 Hearts; supplies deep-wound salves and stamina tonics at 6 Hearts.

characters.name: Valen de Montfort
characters.role: Exiled Noble with Chronic Blood Affliction (2nd Floor Hearth Guest)
characters.description: A highborn Solarian aristocrat suffering from a chronic hereditary blood ailment, pale and sensitive to harsh sunlight. Fleeing court purges, he rents a secluded chamber on the upper floor of The Hearth, relying on Rowan's rich berry cordials and herbal broths to sustain his failing health.
characters.quote: Do not mistake my pallor for frailty. The blood in my veins may falter, but Montfort honor has never bowed to circumstance.
characters.schedule: Daytime: Rests in his curtained upper chamber; Late afternoon: Sips fermented berry cordials downstairs; Midnight: Reads scholarly tomes and drafts diplomatic letters
characters.real_world_wound: Ostracized by royal high society due to a chronic hereditary ailment, left isolated following political purges; craves being treated as an ordinary person rather than a morbid curiosity.
characters.heart_event_summary: Places double-priced custom orders for restorative berry cordials at 4 Hearts; signs prestigious royal court trade charter at 8 Hearts.

characters.name: Kassandra
characters.role: Wind Witch (Sky Express Rapid Air Courier)
characters.description: Nomadic comet sorceress drifting through cloud currents; her enchanted broomstick frequently runs low on mana mid-flight.
characters.quote: My broomstick is running low on arcane ether mid-cloud... Do you have a tea infused with canopy night dew to replenish my spells?
characters.schedule: Wandering through cloud layers and gathering starlight dew
characters.real_world_wound: Exiled by the Solarian Mages Council for researching commoner folk magic; wanders across cloud realms with a broom running out of mana.
characters.heart_event_summary: Opens Sky Express 2-hour inter-realm ingredient air delivery at 4 Hearts; gifts Rowan the Enchanted Flying Broom at 8 Hearts.

characters.name: Chrono
characters.role: Ancient Clockwork Automaton (Town Clocktower & Weekly Calendar)
characters.description: Clockwork relic remaining from a lost civilization; speaks with a rhythmic tick-tock cadence and needs periodic chamomile oil lubrication.
characters.quote: Tick-tock... Left chest gear mechanism grinding... Requesting 200ml warm floral lubricant with chamomile essence... Tick-tock...
characters.schedule: Tending the perpetual clockwork waterwheels in Khaz-Drakor
characters.real_world_wound: Ancient memory modules fragmented across millennia; fears the day mainspring unwinds forever and lost civilisation memories fade.
characters.heart_event_summary: Operates town bell to signal meal hours and displays buff countdown timers on HUD at 4 Hearts; bell resonance boosts tavern revenue by 20% at 8 Hearts.

characters.name: Lapis
characters.description: A buoyant mermaid journeying onto dry land for the first time, delightfully captivated by warm pastries that dissolve on the tongue.
characters.quote: Down in the deep ocean, everything is perpetually soggy... Tasting hot, crispy pastries that melt away like sweet foam is sheer wonder!
characters.schedule: Swimming through misty highland springs and underground lakes
characters.real_world_wound: Profound isolation in silent sea trenches and deep curiosity about terrestrial warmth; fears rejection as a sea-dweller.
characters.heart_event_summary: Trades cloud lake crystal sea salts at 4 Hearts; supplies glowing pearls to craft poison-resistant jewelry at 8 Hearts.

characters.name: Guildmaster Thorne
characters.role: Adventurers' Guildmaster (Bounty Board & Deep Mine Seals)
characters.description: Decorated royal guard captain bearing an iron leg prosthesis. Having lost 18 comrades in deep subterranean vaults, he established the Rescue Outpost with a binding oath: 'No one is left behind in the dark.'
characters.quote: Carelessness in deep shafts is paid in blood. If you collapse down there, my squad will pull you back into the light.
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 22:00: Commanding guild hall operations; Night: Inspecting mine barricades
characters.real_world_wound: Haunted by severe Survivor's Guilt after his 18-soldier platoon perished in the Sunken Necropolis.
characters.heart_event_summary: Opens Deep Mine Monster Bounty Board with generous gold rewards at 4 Hearts; issues Deep Mine Clearance Seals unlocking cross-zone elevators and the Infinite Abyss Gate at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Dậy sớm lau chùi thanh cự kiếm và kiểm tra chân giả
Ghim lệnh truy nã quái vật và cứu hộ hầm sâu
Duyệt hồ sơ cứu nạn cùng Valerie
Đứng nghiêm trang tưởng nhớ 18 đồng đội đã khuất
Ăn phần thịt nướng đậm vị và uống trà ấm

rainy.activity: Thời tiết xấu khiến vết thương chân buốt nhức
Kiểm tra dây thừng và túi cứu thương dã chiến
Gặp Rowan đặt nấu các phần cơm hộp cứu hộ

characters.name: Dispatcher Valerie
characters.description: Former sharpshooter who suffered unilateral hearing damage and acoustic blast PTSD. Meticulously logs rescue reports and coordinates gear retrieval for injured miners.
characters.quote: Your belongings have been secured by our scouts. Value your life over raw ore; tools can be re-forged, lives cannot.
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 20:00: Managing lost items desk; 20:30: Dining at Rowan's Hearth Eatery
characters.real_world_wound: Suffers from acoustic blast PTSD and partial deafness, finding solace in quiet administrative paperwork.
characters.heart_event_summary: Opens the Town Buyback Counter for items accidentally sold to merchants within 3 days at 4 Hearts; recovers misplaced essential tools dropped on the surface at 8 Hearts.

sunny.location: Quầy Đồ Thất Lạc Hiệp Hội
sunny.activity: Sắp xếp balô và vũ khí rơi rớt từ hầm mỏ
Đeo nút bịt tai kiểm tra giấy tờ mạo hiểm giả
Ngồi nơi yên tĩnh hít thở không khí trong lành
Đi cùng Thorne sang ăn tối, thích không gian yên ắng

rainy.activity: Lau khô các trang bị ướt của đội cứu hộ mang về
Trú tiếng sấm chớp giông bão bên lò sưởi ấm

characters.name: Elder Oakwood
characters.description: Silver-haired elder with a resonant voice, leaning upon an antique runic oak staff. Steadfastly sheltered the town through the Great Blight 20 years ago.
characters.quote: I have borne this town for thirty years upon aching shoulders and trembling knees... I am weary, yet who shall shoulder it if I falter?
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 16:00: Town Hall; Evening: Resting at the Hearth Eatery
characters.real_world_wound: Tired Hero syndrome; bore the crushing mantle of sole communal leadership for three decades, terrified of catastrophic failure if he lets go.
characters.heart_event_summary: Oversees the 12-Project Town Board restoration; honors Rowan with the Valley Pioneer Monument at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Reviewing restoration blueprints for communal facilities
Strolling through the square to converse with shopkeepers
Sipping warm hearth tea and consulting with Rowan

rainy.activity: Stoking the ember grate and archiving registry logs
Sheltering from cold downpours alongside fellow village elders

characters.name: Cedar
characters.description: Burly, kindhearted brown bear-kin carpenter whose weathered paws craft breathtaking timber joinery. A quiet artisan whose deep laughter rattles the shop rafters.
characters.quote: They branded me a coward for refusing tribal war... Yet raising a warm roof to endure winter blizzard gales demands far greater courage than swinging a sword.
characters.schedule: 07:00 - 17:00: Carpenter Workshop; 18:30: Hearth Eatery
characters.real_world_wound: Exiled from his native mountain clan for pacifism; branded a coward yet steadfast in his conviction that creation triumphs over ruin.
characters.heart_event_summary: Expands Eatery dining floor at 2 Hearts; rebuilds the Ancient Wooden Bridge connecting to the deep forest at 6 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Hewing pine beams and sizing mortise joints
Harvesting fallen stormwood and seasoned oak branches
Restoring vigor over a piping hot bowl of pumpkin potage

rainy.activity: Carving custom chairs and whittling wooden toys for village children
Enjoying clover honey tea beside the tavern fireplace

characters.name: Wren
characters.description: Nimble halfling clad in a forest-green feathered beret, carrying a cherished antique mandolin. Sings like a dawn thrush yet turns crimson with stage fright offstage.
characters.quote: I-I can sing well enough, really... but the moment people look directly at me without my music, my throat locks tight...
characters.schedule: Afternoon: Riverside rehearsal; Evening: Performing at the Hearth Eatery
characters.real_world_wound: Suffered acute aphonia for three years following the destruction of his homeland; afflicted by severe social anxiety and performance dread.
characters.heart_event_summary: Performs acoustic mandolin at the eatery; unlocks Tavern Music Box at 4 Hearts and Grand Concert boosting patron joy at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Strumming mandolin chords while watching rippling eddies
Entertaining town children with merry folk ballads
Performing warm evening tunes for dining patrons

rainy.activity: Perusing antique sheet scrolls in peaceful study alongside Clara
Fingerpicking soothing acoustic melodies beside the brick oven

characters.name: Hazel
characters.description: Sun-bronzed rancher with an amber ponytail and practical denim overalls. Runs the sprawling dairy and sheep pastures single-handedly with rugged pride.
characters.quote: The heifer herd refused their fresh clover this morning... Perhaps they miss him. I certainly do not. Truly.
characters.schedule: 06:00 - 18:00: Southern Pastures and barn operations
characters.real_world_wound: Abandoned by a merchant spouse who vanished into metropolitan Solaria; fiercely guards her autonomy and spurns assistance out of betrayal trauma.
characters.heart_event_summary: Opens cattle and sheep purchasing at 4 Hearts; supplies the Artisan Butter & Cheese Churner at 6 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Milking cows and distributing morning grain feeds
Guiding the sheep flocks alongside young Tilly onto the hills
Delivering fresh churned butter and dairy pails to Rowan

rainy.activity: Bedding fresh dry straw and securing paddock shutters
Spinning sheep fleece yarn while listening to drum rains

characters.name: Bramble
characters.description: Small, olive-skinned goblin in round spectacles and a tartan vest. Keeps exact abacus ledgers and hoards antique buttons, but conducts strictly honorable commerce.
characters.quote: Squeezing an extra penny from another's misery? I'd rather starve. Bramble may be a goblin, but Bramble has a conscience, understand?!
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 18:00: General Store; Saturday Evenings: Night Bazaar
characters.real_world_wound: Exiled from Solaria's Merchant Conclave for blowing the whistle on counterfeit elixirs; branded a traitor to both goblin kind and wealthy guildmasters.
characters.heart_event_summary: Opens antique curio provisions at 4 Hearts; exclusively hosts the Saturday Night Market with exotic seed pouches at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Unpacking crate inventory and balancing abacus tallies
Trading bulk valley flour for Garrick's sea imports
Counting novelty brass buttons over a warm honey oat porridge

rainy.activity: Securing oilcloth tarps and polishing brass scale weights
Sharing spiced hot tea with passing carriage travelers

characters.name: Rosemary
characters.description: A devoted shrine-keeper bound to the Mother Oak, guarding the Ancient Shrine of Oakhaven. Preserves the sacred memorial purification rites to cleanse post-war battlefield miasma.
characters.quote: Every time an ancient timber in the glade perishes to Star Blight... I feel as though someone has severed one of my own fingers.
characters.schedule: All day: Guarding the sacred stardust shrine and ancient roots
characters.real_world_wound: Grief of witnessing ancient roots corroded by war miasma and burning ash; terrified that when the Mother Oak withers, Oakhaven's soul will fade into oblivion.
characters.heart_event_summary: Dispenses blessed purification springwater at 4 Hearts; conducts the Grand Memorial Purification Feast unsealing the Ancient Memorial Altars at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Sweeping cedar needles from ancient runic altars
Pressing her palms against bark to commune with the grove
Basking in cool evening winds alongside luminous moths

rainy.activity: Collecting rainwater to bathe tender seedling shoots
Lighting fragrant beeswax candles to repel gloomy miasma

characters.name: Tilly
characters.description: Spirited 10-year-old sheep-kin girl with curling horns (one chipped short from past trauma) and fluffy cream-white curls. Loves stargazing and often dozes in haystacks.
characters.quote: Kael and Finn said there are wonderful glowing fireflies in the woods at night... Tilly wants to see them too, but... it's just so scary and dark...
characters.schedule: Morning: Herding yearling lambs; Afternoon: Playing with Kael and Finn
characters.real_world_wound: Suffers severe nyctophobia and post-traumatic anxiety following an old winter wolf attack; longs to appear brave before her peers.
characters.heart_event_summary: Supplies raw fleece wool at 4 Hearts; opens Wool Dyeing Workshop to craft cozy tablecloths granting tavern buffs at 6 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Guiding spring lambs to clover slopes with her little crook
Skipping river stones and solving riddles with Kael and Finn
Drinking warm sweetened honey milk with fresh star cookies

rainy.activity: Grooming wet fleece and sheltering young lambs beside the stove
Drawing crayons illustrations with Kael and Mallow

characters.name: High Smith Grimhild
characters.description: Legendary dwarven matriarch boasting four thick platinum braids and sinewy arms that have hammered out ancient relics. Foster mother of Boris and Bram.
characters.quote: This old smith has forged tens of thousands of mastercraft blades... yet never discovered the craft to re-temper her own broken heart.
characters.schedule: All day: Pounding enchanted metal at the Royal Forge of Khaz-Drakor
characters.real_world_wound: Haunted by the memory of driving Boris and Bram away with unrelenting severity; maternal remorse buried deep behind deafening anvil strikes.
characters.heart_event_summary: Teaches heavy alloy casting at 6 Hearts; unlocks legendary Mithril weapons and armor smithing at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Stoking magma bellows to forge legendary mithril plating
Quaffing deep beet brew and reminiscing over old memories
Inspecting royal vanguard armaments

rainy.activity: Pounding red-hot ingots whose clangs drown out subterranean thunder
Sorting pristine celestial crystals

characters.name: Engineer Cogsworth
characters.description: Slender young dwarf sporting crooked brass goggles and grease-smeared overalls. Intrigued by gears and clockwork, and the only soul capable of deciphering Chrono's cadence.
characters.quote: The clan elders claim I insult our forefathers... But if our ancient ancestors built Chrono, then they were mechanical engineers, not just anvil thumpers!
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 18:00: Repairing pneumatic valves and minecart lines
characters.real_world_wound: Ostracized by conservative dwarven clans for pursuing steam engineering over traditional blacksmithy; struggling with profound intellectual alienation.
characters.heart_event_summary: Crafts Automated Field Sprinklers at 4 Hearts; completes the Minecart Express ore transportation rail system at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Lubricating brass gears and tensioning boiler valves
Conducting trials on a pneumatic steam-cart prototype
Dining on garlicky roasted potatoes with a satisfied sigh

rainy.activity: Applying chamomile lubricant to Chrono's rusted joints
Drafting blueprints for high-pressure irrigation pumps

characters.name: Ember
characters.description: Energetic fire salamander chef with orange-black patterns and an ember-tipped tail, wearing a charred chef's apron. Roasts directly over geothermal magma; Rowan's friendly cooking rival.
characters.quote: Surface folk cringe at my flames... Yet a hearth flame roasting wholesome meat to satisfy empty stomachs — what is fearful about that?!
characters.schedule: 10:00 - 22:00: Cooking at the Khaz-Drakor Lava Basin Eatery
characters.real_world_wound: Barred from surface culinary guilds due to deep prejudice against fire-breathing beastfolk; longs for genuine recognition of his gastronomic artistry.
characters.heart_event_summary: Friendly culinary rival; exchanges fire spices at 4 Hearts and hands over the superheated Magma Roasting Station at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Charbroiling prime boulder steaks over lava jets
Bargaining for deep-sea crystal rock salts
Savoring sizzling spicy skewers with fiery zest

rainy.activity: Simmering spicy stews to warm shift miners coming off deep shafts
Inventing volcanic chili marinade infusions

characters.name: Thistle
characters.description: Lithe moth-folk with silver-violet wings dusted with bioluminescent scales, feathery antennae, and a snowy down collar. Patrols canopy treetops and harvests star-dew.
characters.quote: City lanterns... sting so sharply... Yet moonbeams filtering through forest canopy boughs feel as tender as a mother's lullaby.
characters.schedule: 20:00 - 05:00: Patrolling Sylva-Fae canopy; Day: Slumbering in silk cocoon
characters.real_world_wound: Suffers photic hypersensitivity from blinding glare; isolated by living entirely inverted nocturnal hours from the rest of the world.
characters.heart_event_summary: Patrols canopy boughs at night; gathers Luminescent Silk at 4 Hearts and Golden Silks for seamstress Elora at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Gliding between moonlit spider-silk walkways
Collecting stardust pollen floating upon misty eddies
Sipping calming night lavender infusion before daybreak

rainy.activity: Sheltering from rainfall to protect wing dust scales
Listening to the rhythmic drip of rainfall against the moss

characters.name: Fern
characters.description: Blind ancient elf with flowing silver hair braided with dried roots, sensing all life through the subterranean root network. Sylvan's esteemed former mentor.
characters.quote: I surrendered my sight to the Blight two hundred years ago... Yet through the soil roots beneath my feet, I still 'witness' every dewdrop upon each petal.
characters.schedule: All day: Meditating within the deep Root Sanctum of Sylva-Fae
characters.real_world_wound: Blinded during a solitary stand against primordial Star Blight two centuries ago; bears enduring guilt over failing to save the entire forest.
characters.heart_event_summary: Teaches Primeval Herbal Codex recipes at 6 Hearts; guides permanent soil miasma purification rites at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Touching soil beds to diagnose botanical health
Instructing Sylvan in ancient botanical harmonies
Brewing lotus root potage while communing with dusk winds

rainy.activity: Meditating as subterranean roots drink deep of stormwaters
Grinding ancient herbal powders for soothing salves

characters.name: Valerius
characters.role: Exiled Royal Knight Instructor (Mountain Pass Dojo)
characters.description: Stoic disgraced commander bearing a saber scar across his nose, battered silver armor, and an air of aristocratic dignity. Settles permanently to defend Oakhaven.
characters.quote: My fealty belongs to righteous honor, not to an ornate throne. If that be treason... then I bear the brand with head unbowed.
characters.schedule: 06:00 - 18:00: Drilling town militia and patrolling the North Valley Gate
characters.real_world_wound: Falsely framed for treason and banished from Solaria after uncovering ministerial corruption; deeply embittered by betrayal yet unshakably honorable.
characters.heart_event_summary: Trains combat counter-parry techniques at 4 Hearts; grants Master Parry and +20% stamina recovery at 8 Hearts; forgives former subordinate Hester.

sunny.activity: Practicing combat footwork with his tarnished royal blade
Dining on hardtack bread while drafting defense patrols
Standing vigilant watch against roving mountain wolves

rainy.activity: Consulting regional defense strategies with Guildmaster Thorne
Ordering a hearty wood-fired iron steak beside the fireplace

characters.name: Morrigan
characters.description: Enigmatic marsh witch with raven-black tresses, violet gaze, and a pet crow perched on her shoulder. Gruff and spooky on the surface, but secretly nurse to wounded forest beasts.
characters.quote: You want me gone? No need to yell; I'm accustomed to it. ...Just let me finish bandaging this fox kit outside my door first.
characters.schedule: All day: Marshland Hermitage; Blizzard nights: Lodging at the Hearth Eatery
characters.real_world_wound: Shunned and vilified throughout civilized realms due to superstitious fear of her appearance; isolates herself to preemptively ward off rejection.
characters.heart_event_summary: Concocts weapon-coating monster toxins at 4 Hearts; unlocks Critical Strike Elixir and Miasma Antidote at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Harvesting marsh moss and luminescent toadstools
Splinting fractured wings of fallen forest ravens
Simmering restorative salves under violet candlelight

rainy.activity: Listening to crow caws beside crackling cedar logs
Seeking shelter during howling storms for a cup of frostmint tea

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Bright, earnest scholar with a bouncy auburn bob and round spectacles, constantly balancing towering stacks of antique tomes. Passionate about authentic history.
characters.quote: The royal court ordered me to write that Oakhaven was a barbaric frontier hamlet... Yet beneath every single paving stone here lie fragments of a primordial golden age!
characters.schedule: 08:00 - 17:00: Archival research at the Oakhaven Library with Clara
characters.real_world_wound: Grew up stifled beneath rigid imperial censorship; torn between court loyalty and an unquenchable devotion to truthful historical documentation.
characters.heart_event_summary: Opens Deep Mine Relic Appraisal service at 4 Hearts; completes the Valley Historical Museum at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Deciphering runic tablets alongside archivist Clara
Taking charcoal rubbings of ancient temple stelae
Nibbling ginger biscuits while enthusiastically discussing history

rainy.activity: Burrowed deep within antique chronicles beside the stove
Savoring hot Earl Grey tea in cozy shelter

characters.name: Solace
characters.description: Luminous astral being hovering softly above the sea of clouds in Aethelgard. Ancient guardian who surrendered mortal identity to watch over the stardust threshold.
characters.quote: I have forgotten... my own name... yet this fragrance of lotus tea... someone brewed it for me... so long ago... so... warm...
characters.schedule: All day: Guarding the celestial threshold of Aethelgard
characters.real_world_wound: Millennia of solitary celestial duty; the quiet tragedy of forgotten mortality and yearning for restful peace.
characters.heart_event_summary: Recovers ancient primordial memories; permanently unseals the Aethelgard Skygate linking all 5 realms at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Floating serenely over cloud oceans bathed in aurora light
Listening to stardust whispers echoing from mortal prayers
Gazing quietly upon the turning wheel of cosmic constellations

rainy.activity: Observing thunderstorm lightning flashing across the world below
Absorbing stardust essence into ethereal form

characters.name: Barnaby
characters.description: An aging, meticulous retired Solarian military quartermaster with wire-rimmed spectacles tied with cord, carrying a worn leather ledger. Hired by Rowan to manage the attic bunkhouse, shipping ledger, and estate finances.
characters.quote: Master Rowan, you have dragged half the mine indoors again! Wipe your boots on the straw mat before stepping inside.
characters.schedule: Early: Brews dark tea, cleans bunkhouse; 08:00: Balances shipping ledger; Afternoon: Welcomes travelers; Evening: Counts coins and locks gates
characters.real_world_wound: War destroyed his ancestral home; the painful isolation of an aging veteran fearing he is obsolete and an unwelcome burden.
characters.heart_event_summary: Automates lodging rent collection; -10% building upgrade costs (2H); unlocks 2 new attic guest rooms (4H); market price forecast ledger (6H); homestead vault yielding 3% weekly interest (8H).

sunny.activity: Brews a pot of bitter black tea and recounts copper coin stacks
Logs daily revenues and export receipts from last night's shipment
Tidies traveler linens and inspects bedroom door latches
Welcomes traveling merchants and miners checking in for the night
Locks the heavy timber gate and trims night lanterns

rainy.activity: Drafts emergency requisition list for roof leaks on rainy days
Sips hot tea by the fire, polishes spectacles, and reads land registers
Checks upstairs rooms to ensure rain isn't seeping through shingles

characters.name: Colm
characters.role: Homestead Logistics, Prep Hand & Emergency Bed Return
characters.description: A sturdy, hardworking orphaned youth with sawdust and soot on his arms. Rescued by Rowan from a rockfall at Floor 15 of the Mines; now loyally handles heavy estate chores: chopping firewood, milling flour, collecting dairy, and emergency rescue.
characters.quote: Ask me to cook and I'll blow up the cast-iron pot, but tell me to chop fifty logs or haul you out of the mines, and I'm your man!
characters.schedule: Early: Chops pine logs, fills kitchen racks; 09:00: Mills flour, collects eggs/milk; Afternoon: Carves torches & sharpens pickaxes; Evening: Cleans pens & workshop
characters.real_world_wound: Lost his family during the war, exploited as cheap quarry labor without pay; craves a real home and someone who genuinely trusts him.
characters.heart_event_summary: Gifts sturdy adventurer backpack (+6 slots) (2H); automates flour milling and dairy collection (4H); when Rowan faints in the mine, hauls her safely to bed (dropped items remain lost) (6H); stashes dry firewood and delve torches at the homestead (8H).

sunny.activity: Chops pine logs vigorously and stacks them beside the hearth oven
Grinds wheat into fine flour sacks for Rowan's kitchen
Carves delve torches and sharpens pickaxes on the whetstone
Devours hearty hot stew and warm bread alongside Rowan
Layers clean straw in animal pens and secures barn latch before bed

rainy.activity: Chops wood under shelter so logs remain dry and ready
Inspects grain bags and seals fermenting corn barrels
Oils iron hinges, anvil joints, and farming tools against rust
Warms by the fire, helping Rowan stow heavy cast-iron pots

characters.name: Silas
characters.location: The Hearth Attic Bunkhouse / Front Porch
characters.description: A wiry itinerant trader accompanied by a notoriously stubborn old donkey. Boards at The Hearth on weekends, unlatching battered wooden trunks of rare spice seeds and distant curiosities.
characters.quote: My donkey may be foul-tempered and smell of ditchwater, but the wares strapped to his pack-frame would make capital nobles weep.
characters.schedule: Thursday - Saturday: Boards at The Hearth selling exotic goods; Sunday: Hits the road with his laden pack-donkey
characters.real_world_wound: Lost his merchant caravan and fortune during the wartime border raids; now scrapes by in his elderly years accompanied solely by an old donkey.
characters.heart_event_summary: 15% discount on exotic wares (2H); sells rare foreign spice seeds (4H); delivers rumors and news from beyond the mountain pass (6H); signs weekly wholesale supply contract for the homestead (8H).

sunny.activity: Feeds dry meadow hay to his stubborn old donkey and brushes its burrs
Flings open cedar trade trunks displaying foreign seeds and spices
Sips warm spiced cider and recounts stories of distant frontier passes

rainy.activity: Checks waterproof canvas wraps on dry goods and mends burlap bags
Dries boots by the fireplace, tallies spice seed packets, and plans travel routes

characters.name: Hester
characters.role: Reclusive Former Knight & Armor Maintenance Specialist
characters.description: A cloaked, reclusive deserter hiding beneath a tattered cowl in the corner attic loft. Avoids strangers, yet possesses peerless mastery in restoring heavy military plate armor.
characters.quote: Never ask which crest I fought for. Beneath churned mud and spilled blood, every banner looks identical.
characters.schedule: Daytime: Secreted away in the attic loft mending armor; Midnight: Solitary walks beside the estate pond
characters.real_world_wound: Crushing survivor's guilt after witnessing comrades massacre non-combatants; deserted in horror, living with the constant paranoia of bounty hunters.
characters.heart_event_summary: Teaches armor reinforcement (+10 DEF) at 2 Hearts; restores weapon and armor durability against cracking at 4 Hearts; reconciles with former commander Valerius at 6 Hearts; bequeaths legendary Forsaken Knight's Blade at 8 Hearts.

sunny.activity: Hammers gently on a miniature anvil, reshaping dented steel pauldrons
Gazes quietly through cracked cedar shakes toward distant jagged ridges
Walks through cool nighttime shadows savoring unbroken quiet

rainy.activity: Oils plate gauntlets and replaces rotted leather harness straps
Silently accepts a steaming bowl of stew from Rowan before returning to his room

characters.name: Mae
characters.role: Nomadic Weaver & Finished Home Furnishings Artisan
characters.description: A warm-hearted nomadic weaver wrapped in hand-spun scarlet wool, visiting Oakhaven during autumn and winter. Buys homestead fleeces and goat down at premium rates.
characters.quote: Biting frontier frost is nothing when you have a double-woven wool blanket and a roasted potato straight from the hearth.
characters.schedule: Fall & Winter: Knits beside The Hearth fireplace; Spring & Summer: Migrates across northern highland pastures
characters.real_world_wound: Her nomadic clan was scattered and separated during the border conflicts; journeys across wilderness valleys weaving wool while searching for kin.
characters.heart_event_summary: Buys raw wool and down at +30% price (2H); gifts automated Homestead Loom (4H); sells finished dyed bedding and quilts for bunkhouse rooms (6H); unlocks handcrafted upholstery and tapestries collection (8H).

sunny.activity: Hangs skeins of fresh wool steeped in berry and bark dyes to dry
Swiftly knits wool scarves and heavy winter cloaks for townspeople
Sips wildflower honey tea while listening to travelers discuss pass conditions

rainy.activity: Spins bobbins of raw fleece by the crackling flame
Folds thick, double-loomed woolen blankets into cedar storage chests

characters.name: Old Gomer
characters.location: Surface Quarry & Mine Entrance Powder Magazine
characters.description: A stubborn dwarf living in a canvas lean-to at Floor 60 of the mines, his beard singed black by black powder. Deeply deaf from decades of underground blasts, he sells mining charges and points out unstable ore veins.
characters.quote: EH?! SPEAK UP, LAD! LOST ME EARS WHEN TUNNEL EIGHT CAVED IN THIRTY YEARS BACK! YOU NEED BLASTING POWDER OR WHAT?!
characters.schedule: Daytime: Packs gunpowder casings and sells charges at surface quarry camp; Occasionally: Inspects shallow blast sites; Night: Drinks moonshine by camp braziers
characters.real_world_wound: Deafened in a catastrophic shaft collapse and cast out of the miners' guild; clings to the deep shafts because explosions are the only sound he still feels in his chest.
characters.heart_event_summary: Sells discount Blasting Charges at the surface entrance (2H); teaches recipe for Mega Rock Blasting Bomb (4H); reveals hidden gold veins (6H); gifts handheld Steam Core Drill (8H).

sunny.activity: Crushes sulfur and hardwood charcoal into heavy copper casings
Fires blasting cord, shattering granite to breach rich ore pockets
Swigs potent moonshine straight from the bottle and tunes friction primers

rainy.activity: Dips blasting fuses in tallow wax to seal them against groundwater seepage
Taps rock walls with a ball-peen hammer listening for hollow hidden caverns

characters.name: Vael
characters.description: A reticent diver in a vulcanized fish-skin drysuit, exploring high-pressure flooded shafts at Floor 90 to retrieve ancient artifacts and rare blind subterranean fauna.
characters.quote: A thousand fathoms below the mountain, there is no dawn. Only absolute stillness... and bioluminescent eyes staring back through the black.
characters.schedule: Daytime: Camps by the surface glacial lake sorting lichen; Occasionally: Dives subterranean fissures; Night: Salt-cures fish and repairs diving valves
characters.real_world_wound: Watched his entire salvage crew swallowed by an abyssal trench creature; withdrawn and gripped by the dread of deep water, yet unable to abandon it.
characters.heart_event_summary: Sells Anti-Slip Deep Diving Boots (2H); teaches Luminous Abyss Bait recipe (4H); sells Miasma-Resistant Glow Pearls (6H); opens submerged diving link between mountain lake and river (8H).

sunny.activity: Calibrates air bladder valves on his deep-sea diving helmet
Dives into ink-black depths dredging gem geodes and fossilized nautiloids
Hangs glowing blind cavefish on salt-curing drying lines

rainy.activity: Patches air-hose seals with tree sap and copper wire
Monitors surging groundwater surges feeding from highland storm drainage

characters.name: Rowena
characters.description: An old woods-woman living alone in a smoke-wreathed woodland shanty, soot permanently ground into her weathered face. Produces dense heartwood charcoal that burns three times longer than standard coal.
characters.quote: Town brats call me a soot-hag, but without my kilns their fingers would turn blue before the first hard freeze.
characters.schedule: Daytime: Stacks timber mounds and tends slow-smoldering clay kilns; Evening: Roasts roots beside her kiln shanty
characters.real_world_wound: Lost her husband and son in the frontier garrison defense; retreated into dense woods to find solace in hearth-smoke away from painful memories.
characters.heart_event_summary: Supplies x3 Duration Heartwood Charcoal (2H); teaches Smokeless Earthen Kiln design (4H); -20% coal required for smelting ingots (6H); unlocks Master Ash-Retort Smelting Furnace (8H).

sunny.activity: Chops dried pine rounds, stacking them into conical earthen kiln mounds
Packs river clay over kiln vents, regulating slow smoldering airflow
Unpacks glistening jet-black lump charcoal into coarse burlap sacks

rainy.activity: Lashes heavy waxed canvas over charcoal stores against autumn downpours
Pulls ash-roasted potatoes from the coals and sips cool well water

characters.name: Old Tad
characters.description: A toothless, sun-baked marsh dweller living aboard a mossy, flat-bottomed skiff, smelling perpetually of bog-mud and catfish. Master of weaving bamboo fish-baskets and setting passive weir traps.
characters.quote: An eel possesses sharper wit than half the town. If you want him in your basket, your patience had better outlast the silt.
characters.schedule: Daytime: Weaves bamboo traps and wades reed-beds checking eel pots; Night: Casts drift nets across marsh waters
characters.real_world_wound: His lowland home was ruined when downstream floodgates were blown during the retreat; now drifts solo across forgotten swamp shallows.
characters.heart_event_summary: Gifts Automated Bamboo Weir Trap (2H); teaches Marsh Bait Dough recipe (4H); reveals prime marsh holes for Golden Eels (6H); gifts Thousand-Year Bamboo Rod (+25% fishing bite speed) (8H).

sunny.activity: Splits green river cane with a curved knife to weave eel cylinders
Wades waist-deep placing baited tube traps into cattail roots
Puffs a pipe of cured wild marshleaf and takes a pull of strong cider

rainy.activity: Mends woven throw-nets for high-water catfish runs
Hauls wriggling baskets of fat channel catfish from the weir

characters.name: Milo
characters.description: The rowdiest scamp in Oakhaven, constantly spotted balancing atop orchard stone walls eyeing Rowan's ripe apples and strawberries. If befriended with warm treats, he becomes a nimble woodland scout for hidden forage.
characters.quote: I swear on my slingshot I only climbed that apple branch to rescue a lost moth! Give me a chunk of that hot crusty loaf and I'll show you where the truffles grow!
characters.schedule: Morning: Escapes Clara's lessons at the library; Afternoon: Scopes out fruit orchard fence lines; Evening: Slingshot pebble contests with friends
characters.real_world_wound: His parents are exhausted struggling to rebuild their livelihoods after the war, leaving him largely unattended; acts out to feel seen and valued by adults.
characters.heart_event_summary: Stops stealing fruit and gathers windfalls for Rowan (2H); marks secret forest berry groves on your map (4H); delivers rare wild honeycomb (6H); organizes the Junior Scout Watch warning of wild boars (8H).

sunny.activity: Fidgets with smooth river pebbles and folds parchment gliders
Hides in hazel bushes scouting sun-blushed apples
Shoots acorn targets with a wooden slingshot alongside local kids

rainy.activity: Diverts roof rain puddles with sticks into miniature mud canals
Lingers inhaling cinnamon bun aromas hoping for day-old crusts

characters.name: Little Cora
characters.description: A shy, soft-spoken little girl whose father never returned from the front lines. Spends quiet hours collecting polished pebbles to thread onto cords, expertly grinding colored minerals into brilliant natural fence paint.
characters.quote: Every stone in the creek has its own quiet color. I keep the prettiest ones tucked in my basket for when Father walks up the lane...
characters.schedule: Morning: Forages polished pebbles along stream gravel bars; Afternoon: Strings cord necklaces on the library porch; Evening: Helps her mother cook
characters.real_world_wound: Grieving a father declared missing in action; clings to the quiet childish belief that stringing a thousand colored pebbles will guide him safely home.
characters.heart_event_summary: Gifts Lucky Pebble Bracelet (+5% dodge) (2H); marks secret stream berry patches and gudgeon holes (4H); helps gather windfalls along stream banks (6H); joyful reunion when her father returns safely to The Hearth (8H).

sunny.activity: Wades the shallows gathering gleaming banded quartz pebbles into her woven basket
Carefully threads drilled river stones onto waxed hemp cords
Helps her mother stir wild root broth and tucks her stone basket under her pillow

rainy.activity: Grinds chalky mineral shale in a stone mortar into bright paint pigments
Paints a chimney-smoke cabin onto a split cedar shingle
